task: Parse an AWS S3 bucket name from a full S3 URI and validate that it follows AWS naming conventions
solution_criteria: Regex must extract bucket name from URIs like 's3://my-bucket-name/key/path', validate lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and be 3-63 characters long, without consecutive hyphens or starting/ending with hyphen

task: Write a Python function that formats an AWS CloudWatch log event into a readable string with timestamp, log level, and message
solution_criteria: Function must accept a CloudWatch log event dict, extract the timestamp (converting from milliseconds), log level, and message, and return a formatted string like '[2024-01-15 10:30:45] ERROR: Failed to connect to database'

task: Generate a JSON IAM policy document that grants read-only access to a specific S3 bucket
solution_criteria: JSON must be a valid IAM policy with proper Version, Statement array, Effect set to 'Allow', Actions limited to s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket, and Resource restricted to a specific bucket ARN
